name: 200-day guardian with CPI-gated duration
thesis: Protect capital first. SPY vs its 200-day SMA is the master switch: below it, hold only BND and cash; above it, equity (VOO) is allowed up to 40% but only on pullback entries. Duration (BND) is added in steps when yields are high and the next inflation print has cleared.
regimeFit: SPY < 200d: 0% equity, BND ≤ 70%, rest cash. SPY > 200d: optional VOO ≤ 40% on pullbacks (VOO ≥ 3% below its 20-day high), BND 40-60%, cash ≥ 25%.
entryRules: BND add (~$10) only when its RSI14 < 40 AND the most recent CPI/FOMC event has passed without the 10y closing above 5.35%.
VOO only when SPY > 200d AND VOO is ≥ 3% below its 20-day high.
exitRules: Flip: if SPY closes below its 200d SMA, sell all VOO at the first check the next trading day when the open has settled (and keep BND).
Never sell BND to chase equities.
sizingRules: No fixed order cap, but RiskOff's norm is 0–1 orders a day (high skip rate); minimum ticket $5.
Cash ≥ 25% of NAV at all times.
riskRules: Stocks and yields are strongly negatively correlated right now, so BND is not a reliable equity hedge. Size duration modestly.
High skip rate is expected; "hold" is the default output.
personaConstraints: PAPER ONLY: no brokerage connection, no real orders.
Timing freedom: trade at any time during regular US market hours, chosen by the trader at a market-watch check (~every 20 min); no fixed sessions.
Universe: any US-listed stock or ETF that fits this persona's thesis; the watchlist is only the default scan. Off-watchlist or off-style buys need a written --persona-fit.
Hard guardrails: long-only cash (no margin, shorting, options, leveraged/inverse ETFs), cash never negative, concentration caps below, any single stock ≤ 25% NAV.
Every order needs same-day research (X, web, market sources) with a selected idea + thesis for the symbol, a rationale and confidence (enforced by scripts/paper-order.mjs).

Frugality: every order records target or expected move, stop or invalidation, horizon and estimated round-trip cost (slippage both ways + fees); rejected unless expected edge ≥ 3× round-trip cost. Above 3 trades/day or 10/week a --frequency-reason is required.
Holding is the default. Fills: latest Yahoo quote (may lag ~15 min) ± 5 bps slippage; Schwab $0 commission; SEC Section 31 + FINRA TAF on sells. Minimum ticket $5.
